title: What Is a Dolphin?
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 5, 86-sound stage (wh, ph just added).

pages.illustration: Nell the bee resting on a patch of warm golden sand.

pages.text: Nell looks out at the sea.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee looking out across a wide blue sea.

pages.text: What swims in the deep blue sea?
pages.illustration: A wide view of the deep blue sea, waves rolling gently.
A grey dolphin swimming fast through the open sea.

pages.text: A dolphin is not a fish.
pages.illustration: A dolphin swimming near the surface, breathing at the top of the water.

pages.text: A dolphin must come up for air.
pages.illustration: A dolphin breaking the surface of the sea to breathe.

pages.text: A dolphin can leap up high.
pages.illustration: A dolphin leaping high out of the sea in a graceful arc.

pages.text: When a dolphin leaps, it can flip.
pages.illustration: A dolphin flipping in the air mid-leap above the waves.

pages.text: A dolphin swims with its pals.
pages.illustration: A small group of dolphins swimming together through the sea.

pages.text: Dolphins are fun to spot in the sea.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee watching happily as dolphins leap in the distance.
